IC1: - Patients must be ≥ 3 [AND] and ≤ 18 years of age.
IC2: - The predicted survival period is more than 3 months.
IC3: - According to RECIST version 1.1, there is at least one measurable lesion.
IC4: - Postoperative pathological stage was group II-IV.
IC5: - Patients have [NOT] not received radiotherapy before, [AND] and can accept chemotherapy [OR] and surgical treatment.
IC6: - [NOT] No other anticancer therapy should be used during radiotherapy.
IC7: - The main organs are functioning normally, which meets the following criteria:
IC8: 1. Blood routine examination standards should be met: ([NOT] no blood transfusion within 14 days) A. HB > 90 g/L; B. ANC > 1.5 * 109/L; C. PLT > 80 * 109 /L
IC9: 2. Biochemical tests should meet the following criteria:
IC10: A. BIL < 1.25 times normal upper limit (ULN); B. ALT [AND] and AST < 2.5 ULN; C. Serum Cr < 1 ULN, endogenous creatinine clearance > 50 ml/min
IC11: - Subjects volunteered to participate in this study, patients or legal guardians signed informed consent through patient consent, good compliance, with follow-up.
IC12: - Doctors believe that treatment can benefit patients.
